Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Abstract Pattern Throw Pillow Cover - 20 x 20 Inch, Grey
Colors: Grey
Various tones of grey, black and ivory yarns are woven to form abstract circles on this eye-catching pillow cover. For a different look, it reverses to a solid purple side. This pillow will liven up a transitional or modern style bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. No insert; fits a 20" x 20" pillow insert Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
